title: Ambrogio Bizozola to Maximilian Sforza, Bologna 4 Nov 1529 (BnF fr. 3034 ff. 156-157, DECODE R4224)

documents.shelfmark: BnF, Français 3034, ff. 156r-157v, no. 69 (DECODE R4224); Gallica btv1b90600370 views 246-249
documents.route: Bologna -> France (Maximilian Sforza at the French court)

plaintext.source: No contemporary decipherment; Lasry's key table (05/11/2023) shown on Tomokiyo's cryptiana GL.htm, no published plaintext.

transcription.source: Shape codes transcribed by eye from Gallica full-resolution views 246, 247 and 249 (codes.txt)
transcription.notes: 1914 signs transcribed, all 66 lines of the four pages (non-space characters of cipher.txt; _check_profile --measure counts space-separated words or ASCII letters only, neither fits this code).

system.summary: Letter substitution with invented signs, words spaced, a few homophones and one sign serving a/u and one f/s (Lasry key).
system.notes: Long-loop sign = t; ʒ = a and u; ʃ = f and s; small cross = e; ꝏ a line-end filler; rho-like signs in the date line unread.

prior_solution.where: Lasry key table (05/11/2023) on Tomokiyo, cryptiana GL.htm; no plaintext published there or on DECODE

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Grepped Tomokiyo's GL.htm (saved copy in gramont1529/) for fr. 3034: section names the Bizozola-Sforza cipher and shows Lasry's key image; fetched it.
Gallica SRU dc.source adj 'Français 3034' gave btv1b90600370; contact sheet of views 240-251 located ff. 156-158; natives fetched (one 429 on view 251).
Lines segmented by projection; all 66 lines of ff. 156r-157v transcribed into shape codes by eye.
Lasry's table applied (decode.py): Italian reads at once (per le mie ultime di Cremona; con lo imperatore; al marchese di Monferrato).
Homophones forced by context: long-loop sign = t, ʒ = a and u, ʃ = f and s, small cross = e in the postscript.
All four pages read: partition of the Milanese state discussed in the Emperor's council; Charles V's entry into Bologna; misser Giulio, the Pope; a few lines doubtful.
ꝏ occurs only at line ends where the word runs on (al duca ꝏ / di Savoia): a line-end filler.
Date line 'Bologna, quattro del ... novembre' plus 'domane sarà l'intrata' matched to Charles V's entry into Bologna, 5 Nov 1529.

outcome.notes: All four pages transcribed and read in sense except about six lines of doubtful words and the date numerals; Lasry key plus homophones.

f. 157r ll. 7-8, f. 157v ll. 3-4, f. 156r ll. 4, 16: words not resolved
